name: Editor Timeline Cursor-Demo
sourceNote: Pasted inline in chat with no retrievable file path — analyzed from the rendered image; no source/preview copy could be stored on disk.
semanticDescription: A dark video-editor UI: teal-green clip segments labeled 'TEXT 2/3/4/5' on one track, magenta segments labeled 'TEXT 6/7/8' on another, a blue flagged playhead, and a cursor arrow positioned over a blue folder icon labeled 'TEXT 1' below the timeline.
styleSummary: Editor Timeline Cursor-Demo: dark editor chrome, color-coded clip tracks, a flagged playhead, and a cursor-driven interaction as the demo's engine.

composition.layout: timeline tracks in the upper region, playhead spanning them, folder + cursor below
composition.hierarchy: cursor action > affected clip segment > surrounding track chrome
composition.framing: timeline spans most of the frame width; folder sits in the lower third

typography.characteristics: small bold UI labels, high legibility at small size
typography.animation: labels appear with their clip segment, no independent animation

color.notes: two content-coding hues (teal, magenta) plus a blue playhead/UI accent

motion.primaryMotion: cursor moves to and clicks the folder icon
motion.secondaryMotion: a new clip segment ('TEXT 1') slides/appears on the timeline in direct response to the click; playhead may scrub across the tracks
motion.overshoot: small press-dip on the click, spring settle on the new segment's arrival
motion.stagger: single-action beat, not a staggered group
